selection_reason: Lowest W4 validation loss among the eight fixed runs; no test evaluation

execution.resource_prefix: systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUQuota=400% -p MemoryMax=12G nice -n 10 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
execution.smoke_command: uv run python scripts/run_battles.py --player neural:models/pokedecision-v1 --opponent GymLeader --battles 20 --concurrent 4 --device cuda
execution.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_w4_training.py tests/test_pokedecision.py tests/test_neural_player.py tests/test_w3_data.py tests/test_w4_data.py -m 'not server'
execution.lint_command: uv run ruff check src scripts tests
